title: Announce feature
description: The 20 to 45 second changelog video after Linear, Notion and Slack: what changed, why it matters, show it, where to get it. Covers quick-highlights-over-feature-lists, the UI-in-motion patterns that carry the demonstration, why the CTA points at the feature itself rather than a marketing page, and the recuts for an in-app banner, a changelog embed and a social clip. Load it for a single feature or a small feature set, not a whole-product launch.
summary: The 20 to 45 second changelog video: what changed, why it matters, show it, where to get it.

requires.why: The real feature footage the whole video is built around.
The what-changed and why-it-matters lines, said plainly.
A click on the interaction that matters.
Legibility of the new control is a frame check.

route.deliverable: A 20–45 second changelog video for one feature or a small set
askFirst: Which feature, and what changed for the user?
Do you have a screen recording of it?

models.note: Plain and present-tense, like a real changelog entry.
